sentences.text: Wpcrl/1153/2023 on 18 August, 2023
Author: Ravindra Maithani Bench: Ravindra Maithani WPCRL No.1153 of 2023 Hon'ble Ravindra Maithani, J.
Mr. Shivanand Bhatt, Advocate for the petitioner.
Ms. Sonika Khulbe, Brief Holder for the State/respondent nos.1 and 2.
Mr. Gaurav Singh, Advocate for respondent no.3/the Caveator.
Heard.

The challenge in this petition is made to the FIR/Case Crime No.629 of 2023, dated 27.07.2023,
under Sections 376, 506 IPC, Police Station Manglaur, District Haridwar.
According to the FIR, the husband of respondent no.3 ("the victim") took her in the house of co- accused Rekha, where husband of the informant and Rekha were talking on the first floor of the house.
The victim was in the ground floor.
At that time, according to the FIR, the applicant at the knife point raped the victim.

It is the case of the petitioner that the FIR is false; it has been filed to wreak the vengeance; it is mala fide; the mother of the petitioner had arranged the marriage of the victim with her husband; there were disputes between the victim and her husband because according to the husband of the victim,
the victim had concealed that she had a young child from her first marriage.

It is the case of the petitioner that earlier on 11.07.2023, the victim had lodged a false report against the mother of the petitioner for an incident dated 11.07.2023, alleging that on that date, the mother of the petitioner had assaulted her.
The husband of the informant has also, according to the petitioner, complained against the victim.
The documents have been enclosed in the writ petition.
Having considered, this Court of the view that this matter requires deliberation.
Learned Standing Counsel takes notices on behalf of respondent nos.1 and 2.

Mr. Gaurav Singh, Advocate takes notice on behalf of respondent no.3.
Admit.

1
Counter affidavits may be filed within four weeks.
Two weeks thereafter, rejoinder affidavit, if any, may be filed.
List for final hearing on 14.12.2023.
Having considered, as an interim measure, till the next date of listing, no coercive step shall be taken against the petitioner, provided he cooperates with the investigation.

(Ravindra Maithani, J.) 18.08.2023 Sanjay WPCRL/1153/2023 on 18 August, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/15445552/
